mapper.sql: f.follow_at IS NOT NULL AND f.follow_at >= c.created_at AND f.follow_at <= #{analysisTime}
mapper.select:
WITH eligible AS ( SELECT c.id, c.customer_no, c.customer_name, c.status AS customer_status, c.customer_level, c.created_at FROM customer c JOIN sys_user owner ON owner.id = c.owner_id AND owner.deleted = 0 AND owner.status = 1 WHERE c.deleted = 0 AND c.owner_id IS NOT NULL AND c.status IN ('POTENTIAL','ACTIVE')
AND c.owner_id = #{dataScope.userId} AND owner.dept_id = #{dataScope.deptId} AND 1 = 0
AND c.id = #{customerId}
AND (c.customer_level IS NULLc.customer_level = #{level})
ORDER BY c.id LIMIT #{limit} ) SELECT c.id, c.customer_no, c.customer_name, c.customer_status, c.customer_level, c.created_at, COUNT(f.id) AS history_count, SUM(CASE WHEN THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS valid_count, COUNT(f.id) - SUM(CASE WHEN THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS anomalous_count, MAX(CASE WHEN THEN f.follow_at END) AS last_valid_follow_at FROM eligible c LEFT JOIN follow_record f ON f.target_type = 'CUSTOMER' AND f.target_id = c.id AND f.deleted = 0 GROUP BY c.id, c.customer_no, c.customer_name, c.customer_status, c.customer_level, c.created_at ORDER BY c.id
